title: 85727B0003: Oil Products - Lubricating, Automotive
agency_path: City of New York > Citywide Administrative Services
description_text:
The New York City Department of Citywide Administrative Services ('DCAS') is issuing a solicitation to obtain bids to procure in bulk, lubricating oil products (automotive). See the solicitation documents for additional details. Please submit your proposals by both acknowledging the receipt of the RFX in the Acknowledgement tab and completing your response in the Manage Responses tab. Vendor resources and materials can be found at the link below under the Finding and Responding to RFX heading. If you need additional assistance with PASSPort, please contact the MOCS Service Desk at the below links: https://mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8 and www.nyc.gov/mocshelp PASSPort Vendor Resources https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/getting-started-with-passport.page

For Virtual Bid Opening, please register using the following link: https://events.gcc.teams.microsoft.com/event/a87f1ef4-e3ce-41fa-9749-6a7fa720dcf5@32f56fc7-5f81-4e22-a95b-15da66513bef?source=copyLinkLegacyShareLinkDialog
